note: Invented sample data for trying the agent. Every person, number and address here is made up. The page shows this list only while the data folder is the bundled sample data it was generated from.

callers.name: Margaret Chen

claims.summary: Healthcare claim denied due to missing pathology report and office note

callers.good_for: The main walk-through: a denied healthcare claim that needs two documents, plus closed and open claims of other types. A listed representative (her son) can ask on her behalf.

opening_messages.label: Name, birth date and ID
opening_messages.text: My name is Margaret Chen, my date of birth is March 15, 1985 and the last four digits of my social security number are 4472. What is the status of my denied claim?

opening_messages.label: Her son, as representative
opening_messages.text: Hello, I'm David Chen, Margaret Chen's son. Her date of birth is March 15, 1985 and the last four digits of her social security number are 4472. May I ask about her denied claim?
